bugs.summary: offset // limit gives a 0-based page but paginate() numbers pages from 1, so offset 0 raises ValueError and every other offset returns the previous page (offset 20 repeats items 1-20).
bugs.trigger: list_products_by_offset(0) raises 'page starts at 1'; list_products_by_offset(20) returns product-1..product-20 instead of product-21..product-40.
